description.text: Research direction: Economic Theory and Study of Policies, Comparative Study of Economy of China and America, Economic Study of Modern Developed Countries, Study of Economic Genres and Study of Economic History

duration.text: The Plutonomy at Shanghai Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.
